use-case-cnv-detection-characterisation.text: On HG002 deletions, DRAGEN 4.2 with SV-informed CNV calling found 87 to 100% of deletions in every size bin, with precision 0.99 to 1.00; this is the developers' own benchmark. CNVnator matched it above 10 kb but missed half or more of the deletions under 10 kb. On NA12878, split-read and paired-end callers (LUMPY, DELLY, Manta) recovered about 90% of known CNVs, but only 20 to 33% of their calls were correct; depth-only callers recovered 11 to 43%. No independent evidence here covers duplications, tumour samples or long reads.
